Information Security Standard
Document ID: NS-001
Department: Security
Owner: Security Team
Enable MFA for company email, source-code repositories, and cloud consoles. Store API keys and
access tokens in an approved secrets manager or protected environment variables. Never commit
secrets to source control. Report suspected phishing or data exposure to the Security Team
immediately.

Remote Work Policy
Document ID: NS-002
Department: People Operations
Owner: People Operations
Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Use
company-approved devices and the company VPN for internal systems. Report a lost device or
suspected account compromise to the IT Service Desk immediately. Remote-work arrangements are
reviewed every six months.

Leave Policy
Document ID: NS-003
Department: People Operations
Owner: People Operations
Full-time employees receive 18 working days of annual leave and 8 working days of sick leave per
calendar year. Request annual leave at least five working days in advance, subject to manager
approval. Up to five unused annual-leave days may be carried forward and must be used by 31 March.

Policy

RAG Platform Architecture
Document ID: NS-005
Department: Applied AI
Owner: AI Platform Team

The RAG platform ingests PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV, and HTML. Documents are parsed, enriched with source metadata, and split into chunks. Initial chunking is 800 characters with 120 characters overlap. Embeddings are stored in FAISS. Hybrid retrieval combines vector similarity with BM25 keyword search. Rerank candidates before generation when configured. Answers must cite sources and abstain when evidence is insufficient.

Incident Response Procedure
Document ID: NS-006
Department: Security
Owner: Security Team

Report suspected security incidents to the Security Team as soon as possible. Include the time detected, affected system, observed symptoms, and actions already taken. Do not delete logs or attempt independent remediation unless instructed by the incident lead.

Data Governance Guideline
Data Governance Guideline
Document ID: NS-007
Owner: Data Governance Team
Requirements
Dataset owners must document source, purpose, sensitivity classification, and retention period. Access must follow least privilege. Run data quality checks before publishing critical datasets. Escalate suspected unauthorized disclosure to the Security Team.
